selected_arguments.name: radial_front_relative_braking
selected_arguments.hypothesis: Head-relative coupled braking reaches 0.506 m/s but its strongest corrections fall on J3/J5 in the established front. Regulate downstream module velocity relative to module 5 instead, subtracting the front frame translation and rotation in the encoder-only Jacobian. Upstream joint motion cancels, so front A-D/rolling remains responsible for support while braking acts on the transferring body. Keep damping, threshold, actuator limits and all other parameters unchanged.

configuration.method: measured Bishop/Yamada rolling + A-D shaped-minus-zero correction
configuration.preload: material bending residual; refresh when entering from middle
configuration.principle: measured bending + progressive nominal recovery + measured A-D difference

support_transfer.acquisition: ordered measured prefix, 0.6 s gain transition
support_transfer.source_reference: linearised module radial constraint until measured prefix 12
support_transfer.extra_input: known source contact identities; FK at measured base pose
support_transfer.preload: initial torque-equivalent angle residual in material coordinates
support_transfer.radial_reference: median radius of actual target-contact modules beyond the junction

vertical_rule: Change scene and run name only; identical gains, reference-module index, physics and quality filters. No vertical retuning under this freeze.
scope: Stage 1 horizontal development checkpoint; not autonomous sensing, generalization or hardware validation.
